metadata.content:
You're correct. That would have been drift.
The mission is still:

Finish Runtime Operations first.

Runtime Operations is the production reference implementation.

Only after Runtime Operations is complete do we extract common patterns into the Lumina design system.

The metric cards we were discussing are Runtime metric cards, not LuminaMetricCard as a design-system component.
That means the next work belongs in:
apps/lumina-builder/src/components/workspaces/runtime/parts/RuntimeHeader.tsx
—not in:
apps/lumina-builder/src/components/lumina/workspace/LuminaMetricCard.tsx
The objective is to make the Runtime hero metrics look first-class by refining how they are composed and presented, while leaving the shared component alone until the Runtime workspace has been fully validated.
The refinement should focus on the Runtime-specific presentation:


Premium composition of each metric.


Better hierarchy between primary and secondary values.


Runtime-specific operational accents.


More polished icon treatments.


Better semantic visual language.


Richer footer content.


Better alignment between the four cards.


Stronger visual relationship with the Runtime hero.


Only after Runtime Operations reaches production quality do we evaluate what should be generalized into LuminaMetricCard and the broader Lumina design system.
That's the correct sequence, and I'll keep following it.
